profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Palo Alto Networks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on Cisco’s SD-WAN solution for Enterprise networks.
• Developed automation to perform stability, stress and scale tests.
• Worked on network orchestration and configuration management of the SD-WAN solution.

positions.title: Tech Yahoo! Software Dev Eng (DevOps)
positions.description:
•	Member of Yahoo! CDN team, working on web acceleration, caching and proxy service using Apache Traffic Server. 
•	Working on SSL project to request, renew, or revoke the SSL certificates using Vendor specific API.
•	SSL automation significantly helping a company initiative to set up new SSL cert system in a relatively short span of time.
•	Involve in infrastructure activities installing, configuring, maintaining and troubleshooting the servers.
•	Develop and improve CI/CD and services for development and deployment of the applications and platform.
•	Familiarity with immutable infrastructure and infrastructure as code.
•	Support and troubleshooting of staging/production environments.
•	Support day to day management and deployment of Yahoo’s CDN network using Chef, Jenkins and other tools.

positions.title: Lab Adminstrator at Cisco Networking Laboratory
positions.description:
•	Responsible for maintaining and troubleshooting the LAN.
•	Hands on experience of configuring Cisco routers (3600), switches (Catalyst 2900, 2600) and terminal server (2511).
•	Responsible for upgradation and back up of IOS images using TFTP server, password recovery of routers and switches.

positions.title: Project Trainee
positions.description: • At this antenna manufacturing unit, I studied designing and manufacturing of various types of antenna and developed a database where one just needs to enter the frequency of operation and type of antenna, and software will calculate all its parameter required for manufacturing.

projects.title: Network Traffic Analyzer with DDoS Detection using Python
projects.description:
• Implemented a Network Traffic Analyzer tool in order to geo locate IP traffic, and pin point it on google earth.
	
•  Replicated DDoS attack in Lab Environment and its detection by creating an alert on server side.
	
• Python | Kali Linux | DPKT | PyGeoIP | Google API

projects.title: VoIP Client Application with basic SIP functionality
projects.description:
• Developed a VoIP client-side application in python with basic SIP functionalities like register, unregister and call initiation
	
• Hosted Asterisk server on Linux, analyzed connection flow for different call scenario using wireshark	

• Protocols H.323 | SIP | RTP | RTCP | Linux | Python | Asterisk Server

allTitles: Lab Adminstrator at Cisco Networking Laboratory
